crossRefs.note: You will say to the prophet, ‘What has Yahweh answered you?’ and, ‘What has Yahweh spoken?’

parallels.note: Therefore speak to them, and tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Every man of the house of Israel who takes his idols…

translations.web: You will say to the prophet, ‘What has Yahweh answered you?’ and, ‘What has Yahweh spoken?’
translations.bsb: Thus you are to say to the prophet: ‘What has the LORD answered you?’ and ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
translations.kjv: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
translations.asv: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath Jehovah answered thee? and, What hath Jehovah spoken?
